slides.title: The Problem
slides.task_brief:
THE PROBLEM SLIDE

Headline: 'Scientific Software is Broken'

Left column - The Pain:
- Scientists use 15+ fragmented tools daily
- None of them talk to each other
- $10K-$100K per license annually
- 60% of time spent fighting software, not doing science
- Reproducibility crisis: 52% can't reproduce their own work

Right column - Big number callout:
'$54 BILLION' - Annual global waste from fragmented scientific tools

Include icon representations: frustrated scientist, fragmented tool icons (BLAST, PyMOL, R, MATLAB, GROMACS), clock showing wasted time.

Visual style: Split layout, dark cards with red/warning accents for pain points.

Speaker notes: Let this sink in. These are real numbers from Nature surveys. Every scientist feels this pain.
